blocks.text: A quarterly scorecard to Steerco, an annual outlook to the Board and a live dashboard where the sources allow it.

Four principles run the tracking. Automate before collecting by hand: arrivals, seats and cruise volumes come from feeds that already exist. Name one owner for the dashboard (the programme office) and one for the definitions (Wesgro Research). Report every indicator against its own baseline and both paths. Refresh the register each year at the plan review.
